projects.title: Projects
projects.subtitle: I've successfully delivered a variety of projects. Here's a snapshot of my recent work.
projects.archivesIntro: Explore eight additional projects, presented through the same lens of evidence, context and technical decisions.

aiSystem.name: AiSystem
aiSystem.description: A macOS app to centralize and sync shared resources for Claude and Codex.
aiSystem.carouselDescription: <paragraph>AiSystem is a native macOS app that centralizes project rules, documents, and AI skills to prevent inconsistencies between development assistants such as Claude and Codex.</paragraph><paragraph>I built the SwiftUI interface and local Python/Bash workflows to organize a shared source library, check versions, and control synchronization across projects.</paragraph>

codeMaster.name: CodeMaster
codeMaster.description: PWA for technical training via interactive quizzes with gamification.

allaw.name: Allaw
allaw.description: LegalTech platform combining professional search, appointments and client case management.
allaw.carouselDescription: <paragraph>Allaw is a LegalTech platform connecting individuals with legal professionals. It brings together search, appointment booking and practice tools for managing client cases.</paragraph><paragraph>I built the case-management module from scratch, from data structures to interfaces, and worked on multi-office pages. I also created a shared UI component library for the team.</paragraph>

iconise.name: Iconise
iconise.description: A guided workflow to design, refine, and export application icons.
iconise.carouselDescription: <paragraph>Iconise helps app makers design their icons through a guided workflow, turning an initial brief into visual directions, refined options, and files ready to use in their product.</paragraph><paragraph>The full-stack implementation connects project and iteration management with image generation, transactional credits, billing integrations, and final icon exports.</paragraph>

suggst.name: Suggst
suggst.description: Context-aware answers to meeting questions, directly from a native macOS app.
suggst.carouselDescription: <paragraph>Suggst is a native macOS app for professional meetings and video calls. It helps users answer questions by combining captured speech with reusable reference notes and meeting-specific context.</paragraph><paragraph>I shaped Suggst's product positioning, defined its core interface terminology and guided product iterations, checking user flows and fixes directly in the application.</paragraph>

illustration.label: Suggst macOS app window, ready to start listening

truthify.name: Truthify
truthify.description: Text and YouTube transcript analysis with claim-by-claim reliability scores.
truthify.carouselDescription: <paragraph>Truthify is a web app for exploring the reliability of claims in text or YouTube transcripts, breaking content into individual arguments with assessments and reliability scores.</paragraph><paragraph>I built the analysis workflow, from content chunking to progressive results, connecting a React interface and Next.js APIs to OpenAI-powered processing and PostgreSQL storage.</paragraph>

legalConstat.name: Legal Constat
legalConstat.description: Platform connecting individuals with bailiffs + CRM.

smartflow.name: SmartFlow
smartflow.description: Flashcards and an automatic review schedule to help knowledge stick.
smartflow.carouselDescription: <paragraph>SmartFlow is a web app that helps students and other learners turn knowledge into flashcards and review it at the right time through a spaced-repetition schedule designed around each card.</paragraph><paragraph>I developed the card creation and review flows, a scheduling engine for due dates, and a progress dashboard, backed by an API, PostgreSQL persistence, and automated tests.</paragraph>

decorNature.name: Décor Nature
decorNature.description: Showcase website for a painting and decoration company.

aimoto.name: Aimoto
aimoto.description: A local lab to experiment with, backtest and compare daily Bitcoin forecasts.
aimoto.carouselDescription: <paragraph>Aimoto is a local lab for daily Bitcoin analysis. It brings together data preparation, predictive model evaluation and historical comparisons to support structured research experiments.</paragraph><paragraph>I worked on the Next.js interface and Python services, covering experiment setup, execution tracking, results exploration and reliability checks across the application's research workflow.</paragraph>

liic.name: LIIC
liic.description: Chrome extension for generating AI-powered LinkedIn comments.

teslaApp.name: Is Tesla Worth It?
teslaApp.description: A calculator to compare the total cost of ownership between two vehicles.

emmausConnect.name: Emmaüs Connect
emmausConnect.description: Platform for managing and refurbishing donated smartphones.

wilderGame.name: Wilder Game
wilderGame.description: A web-based quiz game about movie release dates.

faq.title: Do you have any questions?
faq.intro: Find answers to the most frequently asked questions.

items.question: What inspired you to work in web development?
items.answer: Discovering computers early made me love creating and experimenting. The web showed me a space where creativity and technical problem-solving meet, and that blend is what inspired me to pursue it as a career.

items.question: What do you look for in a professional environment to do your best work?
items.answer: I perform at my best when there’s trust, real autonomy, a clear product vision, and a healthy work environment where everyone can move forward with focus.

items.question: What type of organization allows you to be most effective in your daily work?
items.answer: Asynchronous operations with well-planned checkpoints. I'm at my best when I can organize my focus blocks, document properly, and move forward without constant interruptions.

items.question: What makes my profile an asset for a company?
items.answer: I’m autonomous across the entire workflow: concept, design, specs, code, tests, and delivery. I bring a pragmatic product mindset, integrate quickly, take initiative, and enjoy both building and refining a project.

items.question: What role do AI tools play in how you work today?
items.answer: They’re central to my workflow. I regularly test new models to save time, explore ideas, and maximize efficiency in a field that evolves extremely fast.
